subject: Marine Works - Fraser River
text:
Marine Works - Fraser River
Pile driving and crane operations taking place in Deas Slough in the vicinity of 49 06.882N 123 03.915W. 
Hours of operation from 140OUTC Nov 16 until 0200UTC Nov 21st. 
Vessels on site monitoring VHF Ch. 16, 74 and 71. 
Mariners are advised to avoid the marine construction area.
